slides.headline: Three mutual fund myths, gently corrected
slides.subhead: Short answers for the questions families ask most.

points.title: Myth: needs lakhs
points.text: Fact: many SIPs start at a few hundred rupees a month.

points.title: Myth: money is stuck
points.text: Fact: open-ended funds can be sold any day. Some have exit loads or lock-ins.

points.title: Myth: it is gambling
points.text: Fact: funds follow a stated strategy and carry market risk.

slides.headline: Facts first. Then decide.
slides.cta: Save this for your next family chat
slides.footnote: Read all scheme related documents before investing.

caption: Three common myths, three simple facts. Mutual funds are not only for the wealthy, and they are not a gamble, but they do carry market risk. Always read the scheme documents. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #MoneyFacts #India #FinancialLiteracy
